votes.motion: Approve the variance for 217 Reservoir Road (groundwater offset from 5 feet to 4 feet and system less than 100 feet from a wetland).
votes.quote: after discussion and on motion by jewell and second by fortin, the variance was approved. all in favor.

votes.motion: Approve the variances for 145 Woodland (groundwater reduction from 4 feet to 3 feet and less than 12 inch tee separation) with a two-bedroom deed restriction condition.
votes.quote: after discussion and on motion by passios and second by mayhew, the variances were approved with the condition that a two (2) bedroom deed restriction be placed on the property.

votes.motion: Approve the variances for 169 Penninsula Drive (groundwater, tee separation, garage slab and house slab offsets).
votes.quote: after discussion and on motion by mayhew and second by fortin, the variances were approved. all in favor.

votes.motion: Allow the installation of the new well at 950 Chase Road to go forward, with a variance for exact placement to follow once the distance is known.
votes.quote: after discussion and on motion by passios and second by fortin, the board voted to allow the installation of the well to go forward.
